exposure: Hyperglycemia in pregnancy (HIP) status, categorized as no HIP
cohort: The study included 8,339 women screened for hyperglycemia in pregnancy after 22 weeks of gestation from a multiethnic prospective study.
finding: Compared with no hyperglycemia in pregnancy (HIP), fasting HIP was associated with a higher rate of large-for-gestational-age infants, while post-load HIP was associated with higher preterm delivery and neonatal intensive care unit admission rates.
